notes.title: v1.4 update notes
notes.content:
[h2]What's new[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added 15 new chapters 10 new weapons.
[*] Added a mini tps test chapter.
[*] Reworked the lighting at 3rd chapter.
[*] Improved the snow in 5th chapter.
[*] Added animating plane and a new gun to chapter 9.
[*] Changed the way the pixel dlc version runs to save disk space.
[*] Performance improved. Known bugs fixed.
[*] Auto-save feature has been added between levels.
[*] Radar visual changed.
[/list]

notes.content:
